items.evidence: I re-captured on the current build with max_units_ab --variants all, seed 23 t 540, using the same picks as verify1's v1q2, plus a new seed 31 t 300 (shots in _harness/_shots/maxunits/v2q2a and v2q2b). The sim has diverged since verify1, so poses differ; compare the crops by eye, not pixel by pixel. Vashil's hood is now lilac with a violet cowl, where round 1 had a cream hood; this is the clearest gain. Kemdo's hood reads coral instead of cream. Rishal's crimson now reaches her torso and legs at both seeds. Burdam still reads cream-topped from the camera: his hood and backpack mass belong to the cards lane, and the oxblood pauldrons are a small area.

The claimed hat is dusty plum at L* 55, C 14, but at the gameplay camera it renders as a bright candy pink. The median Lab on the hat crop (v2q2a tunlan_4) is L* 80.1, C 33.9, h 322. That puts it on the same hue as Dunsom's lilac round hat (v2q2b dunsom_10: L* 72.9, C 22.7, h 322). Both fighters now read top-down as a wide pale pink-lilac disc over a purple robe. Hat-to-hat dE76 fell from 44.6 in round 1 (Tunlan's cream hat, L* 84 h 75) to 13.3 now. Tunlan's signature-hue pixels rose, but telling two fighters apart is a bigger readability loss.
There is no change this round. No cloth, leather or lacquer separation is visible in my 28.5 m crops.

The decision that glass reads by reflection is reasonable and stays inside the 39-program count. In u6_glass_gamecam_ab.png I see no difference between the two columns on any of the 8 crops, and the engineer measures a mean diff of 0.18-0.27 levels. A League-level player sees nothing.

Only a spec was written, plus the albedo crown breaks above. Ten fighters still have cream, low-detail heads and hoods and have no head modelling yet. My seed 31 crops show it: Ervet, Marund, Odrum and Burdam all lead with cream heads and hoods.

I ran value_probe --monsters glasshorn at a new seed (41, t 80): dL* p50 24.5, dE 35.1, unitPx 18,314, which reproduces the claim. In the native-scale crop the rib-cage read is gone: a lilac stag with a small ring mark on the haunch, nothing that runs parallel to the ribs, and no horror read. Its icon still shows the fawn; the icons lane owns it.

At a new seed (41, t 400), value_probe gives unitPx 68,417, dE 44.8 and dL 37.9, all passing the 51,944 gate. Seed 19 now clears the gate by only 1 % (52,464). In r2_sunsplinter_tip_ab.png the slab still covers most of the orb at seed 19, so this fixes a gate margin, not something a player sees.
